title: Fougasse (Provençal Leaf Bread)
summary: An olive-oil dough shaped into leaves, slashed open and baked hot until golden and crisp.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
semolina or flour, for the trays

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast and salt with the water and oil to a shaggy dough and rest 15 min.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Knead 5 min until smooth, then cover and leave 1½ h, stretching and folding the dough over itself 3 times in the first hour.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide in two and press each on a lined, semolina-dusted tray into a 30 x 20 cm leaf shape.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut a long slash down the centre and 3-4 angled slashes on each side, cutting right through, then pull the cuts wide open with your fingers.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 30 min. Heat the oven to 240 °C (220 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with oil and bake 18-22 min until golden and crisp; brush once more as they come out.

tips: Pull the cuts wide; they close up as the dough rises.
Lightly oiled hands make shaping easier.
storage: Best fresh; re-crisp in a hot oven for 5 min. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
